items.headline: City issues eight ADU permits in single week
items.summary: All eight building permits issued between July 22–24 are for accessory dwelling units, ranging from a 748-sq-ft detached unit on Prunetree Ct to attached ADUs on Foxworthy Ave and S 5th St, with construction values from about $97,000 to $172,000. The cluster shows ADUs, not new single-family homes or commercial projects, are driving most residential building activity in San José right now.

items.headline: Cupertino faces at least three active lawsuits
items.summary: The City Council's closed session included discussion of pending litigation: Lixin (Leon) Chen et al. v. City of Cupertino, Yes in My Backyard et al. v. City of Cupertino, and Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino, all in Santa Clara County Superior Court.

items.headline: Sunnyvale to weigh oversized front-yard fence request
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled to consider a use permit for an 8-foot-9¾-inch-tall fence in the front yard of a single-family home at 1617 Edmonton Avenue — nearly three feet above the standard 6-foot limit.
